rows.note: the Lost Knife Hideout boss borrows its level from the common bandits: it takes only `Stats`, `BaseData` and `Inventory` from `LCharBanditMelee2H` 03DEC8 (*Common Bandits*), so it rolls 1 · 5 · 9 · 14 · 19 · 25 (every gate at or below the player). Changing that ladder changes it. Alias `drunkBoss` of `dunLostKnifeQST` 034C90. Moved here from Uncategorised → *Unfiled Leveled Wrappers* (user, 2026-10-03).

items: Changing any vanilla boss leaf also needs `ccBGSSSE050_BountyHunter` 000823:ccbgssse050-ba_daedric.esl (Bounty Hunter, PC×1.5 [10–50], on World → *Falkreath Countryside*): its template is `LvlBanditBoss` 03DF17, which draws them, with no template flags at all.

Changing the Nord male leaves (`EncBandit0{2–6}Boss{1H,2H}NordM`) also needs `dunFrostmereCrypt_Kyr` 0D37D1 (Kyr, 1, on *Named Bandits*): its template is `LvlBanditBossNordM` 01B0E1, which draws them, with no template flags.

Changing the Nord female leaves (`EncBandit0{2–6}Boss1HNordF`) also needs `dunMistwatchFjola` 090739 (Bandit Leader, PC×1.1 [5+], on *Named Bandits*): she takes `Traits` and `Inventory` from `LCharBanditBossNordF` 01A340, not `Stats`.

Changing the Orc leaves (`EncBandit0{2–6}Boss2HOrcM`) also needs `WEDL05Thug` 0B91B0 (Thug, PC×1.15 [5+], on World Encounters → *Random Encounter NPCs*): it takes `Traits` and `Inventory` from `LCharBanditBossOrcM` 01B0EA, not `Stats`.

Changing `EncBandit02Boss1HRedguardF` 03DEE2 also needs `dunIronbindSalma` 06CD5A (Salma, PC×1 [3–26], on Uncategorised → *Unfiled NPCs*); changing `EncBandit06Boss1HNordM` 03DF09 also needs `ccBGSSSE016_UmbraBoss` 000801:ccbgssse016-umbra.esm (Umbra, PC×1.25 [26–100], on World → *Whiterun Countryside*): each uses the leaf as its template with no template flags.
The Lost Knife Hideout boss follows the common bandit ladder; the records that keep their own level beside it are listed on *Common Bandits*.
The other rows (the CC armour-pack leaves, the chief wrappers, the Traitor's Post boss, `LvlNPCArenaOpponent`): no other record keeps its own level.

Every other record that draws a boss list or wrapper carries `Stats` and follows it: the chief wrappers above, the Hired Thugs (*Hired Thugs*), Eisa Blackthorn, Ghunzul and Viparth (*Named Bandits*), the Haknir's Shoal Pirate Captain (*Reavers*), the Silver Hand boss, Sarthis Idren, Stalleo's Bodyguard, the WE36 Bounty Hunter and the Bounty Collector, the Dawnguard Hunter, the Lost Paladin ghost, Valdar's ghost, the `WE17` Soldier, the Pit's Fellow Prisoner, the dead Eigorn and Makhel Abbas: each list row below names them under *Drawn elsewhere*.
